meta.description: Ha-makom she-bo mi she-magi'im ba-pa'am ha-rishona makirim haverim hadashim ba-mifgashim u-va-kenasim shel kehilat ha-furry. Mi-beit Global Furry Television.
site.name: GFTV HelloSpot
official.line: Atar rishmi shel Global Furry Television
official.domain-heading: Atarei GFTV ha-rishmiyim mistaymim be-globalfurry.tv o be-gftv.asia
official.domain-body: Kir'u et ha-ktovet me-ha-sof, ba-nekuda ha-aharona lifnei ha-lokhsan ha-boded ha-rishon. Atar she-mistayem be-khol davar aher eino shel GFTV, gam im ha-shem mofi'a mukdam yoter ba-ktovet.
official.trusted-link: Ha-reshima ha-mle'a shel atarei GFTV ha-rishmiyim
official.secure-body: Hapsu semel shel manul, o vad'u she-ha-ktovet matkhila be-https://. Shatfu pratim ishiyim rak be-atar rishmi u-ve-hibur me'ubtah.

update.ready: Girsa hadasha shel GFTV HelloSpot mukhana.
hero.card-alt: Kartis ha-shem shel HelloSpot. Katuv alav Hello ve-哈喽 le-tzad hiyukh gadol, me'al pasei ha-keshet shel GFTV.
hero.title: Matzatem HelloSpot!
hero.lede: Ba-mifgashim u-va-kenasim shel kehilat ha-furry, ha-HelloSpot hu ha-makom she-bo mi she-magi'im ba-pa'am ha-rishona makirim haverim hadashim.
how.title: Eikh HelloSpot oved
how.spot.title: Hapsu et ha-hiyukh
how.spot.body: Hapsu et ha-HelloSmile al kartis, al srokh o al shelet. Eifo she-hu nimtza, sham yesh HelloSpot.
how.hello.title: Tagidu shalom
how.hello.body: Bo'u lehagid hai. Af ehad ba-HelloSpot lo metzape she-takiru mishehu adayin.
how.friend.title: Takiru haverim
how.friend.body: Hakiru et mi she-svivkhem, ve-tetz'u im mishehu lehapes ba-mifgash ha-ba.

about.title: Global Furry Television
about.body-1: Global Furry Television (GFTV) hu arutz ha-hadashot ha-gadol be-yoter shel kehilat ha-furry be-Asya, u-vsiso be-Singapur.
about.body-2: Anahnu matzigim et ha-tzmiha shel kehilat ha-furry kedei she-kulam yukhlu leha'arikh ota ha-yom u-mahar, u-me'arhim merhavim she-bahem anashim yekholim lehakir u-lehavin ze et ze.
about.body-3: Ha-tzevet shel GFTV paruss me-ha-bayit al pnei ha-yabashot ha-gdolot, ve-hu beinle'umi, rav-tarbuti ve-rav-leshoni.
